item.title: Trump Says New Air Force One Will Be Taken Out of Service to Be ‘Maxed Out’
item.description:
Presidential Politics Meets Airborne Security

Donald Trump has announced that the new, Qatari-donated Air Force One will be temporarily removed from service to ensure it meets the security needs of the U.S. president and other high-ranking officials. The decision comes amidst ongoing concerns over the aircraft’s defensive capabilities.

In a statement, Trump said the plane will be taken out of service to be “maxed out” with additional security features. Details on the specific enhancements are still scarce, but officials have confirmed that modifications will be made to upgrade the aircraft’s defenses before it returns to active duty. The exact timeframe for the upgrades and the plane’s expected return to service has not been disclosed.

item.title: World Cup 2026: Spain v Argentina countdown, Trump to attend final, England news – live
item.description:
The Road to Glory: Spain and Argentina Set to Clash in World Cup 2026 Final

Sunday’s highly anticipated World Cup 2026 final between Spain and Argentina is fast approaching, with the anticipation building for a thrilling encounter between two of the world’s top football nations. The stage is set for a spectacular conclusion to the tournament, and the stakes are high as both teams vie for the coveted trophy.

Donald Trump, in a surprise move, has announced that he will attend the final, with White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt confirming the news on Thursday. Leavitt expressed the White House’s enthusiasm for the match, stating, “We look forward to the final match on Sunday, and I know the president looks forward to attending. This is a fitting conclusion to a tournament that showcased America’s ability to host the world on the grandest stage.”

item.title: Harry Kane reveals he played golf with Donald Trump days after US President praised England striker
item.description:
A Surprising Par on the Green: Harry Kane’s Secret Golf Round with Donald Trump

Harry Kane, the 32-year-old England striker, has revealed a unique experience he shared with Donald Trump, the President of the United States, just days after Trump praised Kane’s performance in a 3-2 victory against Mexico. The Bayern Munich player, who has enjoyed a remarkable season in the Bundesliga, has opened up about a round of golf he played with Trump 18 months ago in Florida.
